Telangana’s minimum temperature between 18℃ and 25℃ on October 30 morning; 22.2℃ in GHMC
 Thunderstorms were forecast in 11 Telangana districts between afternoon on Friday and morning on Saturday
 Updated - October 30, 2026 02:00 pm IST - HYDERABAD 
 The Hindu Bureau READ LATER 
 SEE ALL 
 Remove 
 Minimum temperatures across Telangana recorded at 8.30 a.m. on Friday (October 30, 2026)
 | Photo Credit: BY ARRANGEMENT
 Temperatures in Telangana, which dropped under the impact of cyclonic storm Arnab , continue to be relatively low as the minimum temperatures between 18℃ and 25℃ were recorded in various parts of the State on Friday (October 30, 2026) morning. 
 The minimum temperature — recorded at 8.30 am. — in Medak was 18.8℃, followed by 19.7℃ in Adilabad, 20.2℃ in Dundigal, 20.5℃ in Hanumakonda and 20.6℃ in Khammam, as per India Meteorological Department-Hyderabad Centre’s weather information.
 In Greater Hyderabad Municipal Corporation (GHMC) limits, the minimum temperature of 22.2℃ was recorded in Patancheru, 22.5℃ in Rajendranagar, 22.6℃ in Hayatnagar and 23.4℃ in Begumpet.
 The maximum temperature was 34℃ in Mahabubnagar, and it was 32℃ in Begumpet (GHMC).
 Thunderstorm forecast in 11 districts
 The temperatures may continue to be low as 11 districts were forecast to receive thunderstorms between afternoon on Friday and morning on Saturday. India Meteorological Department-Hyderabad Centre in its seven-day forecast has predicted thunderstorms accompanied with lightening and gusty winds as very likely at isolated places in Mulugu, Bhadradri Kothagudem, Khammam, Nalgonda, Suryapet, Mahabubabad, Warangal, Hanumakonda, Jangaoan, Siddipet and Yadadri Bhunavanagiri districts.
